column1: # gate-m59 (run/gate-m59-forge-swap.sh): EXACTLY what the Forbric arm of the Forge->NeoForge build swap loses, as
# forge-swap.py pin measures it against the frozen native arm. Owner ruling D77 (O1, "document only"): these losses
# are the mods' own format, which the native MinecraftForge 26.2-65.0.1 -> NeoForge 26.2.0.93 swap loses too; they are
# documented (release notes / compatibility list), never migrated, and a Forbric-caused loss is fixed, never added here.
# A row stays only while the gate measures it lost with its verdict (pin `stale` otherwise); a loss not listed is red
# (pin `unpinned`). Keys and verdicts are forge-swap.py classify's, copied from the measuring run (lane SWAP wave 2b,
# 2026-11-11, fixture ~/Forbric-backups/forge-swap-w2b). The packedup bags (a chest's and the player's, filled on the
# old side) lose nothing and so have no row. Columns are tab-separated.
